notes: Owner specification-review ruling of 2026-09-02, given as BATCH 4 over the corrected theorem at commit 6d88f8db, after the owner declined the previous version on two bounded grounds. This is the theorem's FIRST owner specification review; the declined version carries no record and no approval was transferred to it. FAIL-CLOSED PROPOSITION. Approved: under the fleet-strict posture a request does not reach backend dispatch unless the required replay state has been established. The four distinct refusals are accepted as distinct — no declared replay tier; a declared tier below the strict-production minimum; a store whose own durability class is weaker than the declared posture; and a store that does not return the required atomic admission result. The replay-store operation remains the final replay-admission step, and infrastructure failure does not degrade to process-local or fail-open admission. MECHANISM-SPECIFIC DURABILITY. Approved in its corrected mechanism-neutral form: successful replay establishment carries exactly the durability semantics of the selected registered mechanism premise and no stronger. Under Redis, ASM-0040 gives configured replica acknowledgements and carries its documented failover caveat; it is NOT linearizable replay durability. Under etcd, ASM-0041 gives a successful linearized transaction and a lease-bound cluster-wide key. The owner explicitly approves the non-claim that REDIS_WAIT_QUORUM does not guarantee that every later failover preserves the nonce, and rules that THM-0092 may not later be used to upgrade Redis WAIT semantics into the stronger etcd proposition. REPLAY VERSUS EXECUTION, approved AND REQUIRED. Replay admitted, backend dispatched and backend executed are three distinct states. A replay verdict establishes that the replay key or signed request was already admitted and recorded under the selected replay mechanism; it does NOT establish that the backend was previously dispatched or executed. An outage establishes that this attempt did not obtain the replay-establishment fact dispatch requires, so this attempt does not reach the backend; it does NOT establish that no store-side write occurred, because an acknowledgement can be lost after a write. THM-0092 is not a general client retry-policy theorem. SCOPE. The one-directional reading is approved: an unestablished replay state does not dispatch, and this is not a liveness claim — it does not say that every successfully established replay state must dispatch. The separation between the operator-declared replay tier, the replay store's own reported durability class, and the foreign semantics of the selected distributed mechanism is accepted, and those three must remain distinct propositions. The approval was made conditional on immediate remeasurement; the fingerprint was recomputed at 6d88f8db before this record was written and equals the value the owner named. `theorem_dependencies` carries THM-0086's claim digest, and THM-0086 is itself owner-reviewed at that digest.
